title: Coherent reduction of ordinary pullback and its forward adjunct
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, and let $f:X\to Y$ be any scheme morphism. Use the completed coefficient sheaves of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Let $F_f$ be their ordinary ringed derived pullback, and let $\rho_f:F_f\to\widehat F_f$ be the specified forward comparison of [lem-sf-integral-ordinary-pullback-comparison], defined as pullIso followed by the quotient/zero completion comparison of [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback]. For $W=X,Y$, write $L_W\dashv R_W$ for the coherent reduction/limit adjunction of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], with unit $\eta_W$. Let $P_f$ be the exact derived inverse image on the ringed sequence sites of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core], and let $e_f:\widehat F_f\simeq R_XP_fL_Y$ be the full strict-model realization of [lem-pur-integral-pullback-roos-realization]. There exists a natural isomorphism $a_f:L_XF_f\simeq P_fL_Y$ whose adjunct on every ambient derived object $K$ is exactly $\rho_f(K);e_f(K)=\eta_X(F_fK);R_X(a_f(K))$. Its uniqueness is proved separately from the adjunction Hom bijection. No tensor, constructibility, invertibility of $\ell$, properness, Noetherianness or dimension hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Construct the unit-normalized comparison and verify the displayed adjunct equation on every good flat-term K-flat representative. The ordinary pullback comparison and the strict Roos realization have identical finite projections, so product and mapping-cocone extensionality identify the representative maps.

Descend the representative equation through the good-complex localization. Naturality of the comparison maps and faithfulness of the localization identify the two natural transformations on every derived object.

In the proved uniqueness corollary, two such natural isomorphisms have equal adjuncts at every object. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection, natural-transformation extensionality and isomorphism extensionality identify them.

theorem pullbackReductionAugmentation_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ a : PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f ⋙
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).reduction ≅
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).reduction ⋙ pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f,
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E Y),
        (pullComparison l E f).app K ≫
            (pullbackTensorIntegralPullbackModel l E f).hom.app K =
          (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).adjunction.unit.app
              ((PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f).obj K) ≫
            (coefficientSequenceLimit l E X).map (a.hom.app K)
